description: Dark Heresy 2nd Edition, Table 7-17 (p. 239). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: Challenging (+0) Toughness test or suffer 1 level of Fatigue.
-10 to Perception and Intelligence tests for [[1d5]] rounds.
Blinded for 1 round. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or Stunned for 1 round.
Challenging (+0) Toughness test or Stunned for 1 round and knocked Prone.
1 level of Fatigue, Stunned for 1 round, staggers back [[1d5]] metres. Intelligence permanently reduced by 1.
Stunned for [[1d5]] rounds and knocked back [[1d5]] metres. Challenging (+0) Agility test or knocked Prone.
Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds. Movement halved (rounding up) for [[1d10]] hours.
The target dies. Everyone within 4 metres must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility test or take -10 to Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill tests on their next turn.

As result 9. The attack carries through: with a melee weapon the attacker may immediately attack any other target he can reach without moving; with a ranged weapon, any target directly behind the original and within range.
